prompt: Origin: rendered in-browser from the original procedural three.js model in apps/web/src/components/cuppy/scene.ts (swirl geometry in swirl.ts, spoon in spoon.ts, strand in strand.ts) and the original rubber-hose face drawn in apps/web/src/components/cuppy/face.ts. Captured by a Playwright script that forces the hero slot to a 720x1068 CSS stage at 1.5x DPR, hides the page copy and background, screenshots the slot with transparency and re-encodes it with canvas.toDataURL("image/webp", 0.86). Pose: the reduced-motion still pose (spoon lifting the top on a short neck of cream; Cuppy's face between the scoop and lift beats: glasses perked up, round eyes on the spoon, a small closed smile). Vanilla is the page's single art-directed cream; the earlier poster-vanilla/chocolate/salted-caramel renders are kept for history but no longer referenced. No brand artwork, game artwork, photography, or generated imagery. The pixel sunglasses are a user-approved nod to the Cuppy mascot; Cuppy brand rights apply (publication permission pending).
